sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-GGUF is a 7.6 billion parameter, instruction-tuned code-focused language model from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team, distributed in quantized GGUF format for efficient local inference. It supports 32K context (up to 128K with non-GGUF versions) and is designed for code generation, debugging, and reasoning tasks.
